title: Emrys and the Garden
author: E. M. Delacroix
blurb: Elodie Delacroix, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
